rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese noun for a projectile shot from a bow.

example.english: You need to pull the bowstring tight before shooting an arrow.
example.jyutping: se6 zin3 jiu3 sin1 laai1 gan2 gung1 jin4

rows.note: A speaker uses 箭嘴 for an arrow-shaped sign or symbol indicating direction.

example.english: When you see the arrow, follow it and you won't go the wrong way.
example.traditional: 見到箭嘴就跟住行，唔會行錯路。
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 zin3 zeoi2 zau6 gan1 zyu6 haang4 m4 wui5 haang4 co3 lou6
